Joy de Zeeuw (born 15 May 2006) is a Dutch professional tennis player. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Early life [ edit ] De Zeeuw is from Vlaardingen , South Holland , the daughter of a tennis coach. [ 4 ] She began playing tennis at the age of three years-old. [ 5 ] [ 6 ] Career [ edit ] She made her junior Grand Slam debut at the 2024 Australian Open . [ 7 ] She lost to Mingge Xu at the 2024 Wimbledon Championships – Girls' singles . [ 8 ] She became European U18 doubles champion alongside Britt du Pree in 2024. [ 9 ] She won her first professional title in Villena, Spain in October 2024 and won her second the following month in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt. [ 10 ] de Zeeuw won her first major $75k title at ITF The Hague in Netherlands in the doubles draw, partnering Arantxa Rus .
